-- Phase 1 spec. Any name is accepted, so there is no `pre`.
-- The body will confine `fs` to `notes` with `fs.sub("notes")`.
-- A missing or unreadable file, or any name that escapes `notes`, gives "".
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_note("no_such_note_here.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("/etc/passwd") == ""
  ex read_note("") == ""
  var text = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    text = fs.read(name) else ""
  text
